label: input s at position 0 or 1
explanation: Fires when the input token is the letter s at one of the first two original-phase steps (t=0 or t=1). Coverage is about even between t=0 and t=1. It also fires at t=1 when s was the token at t=0 too (s s). It never fires on s at later positions, apart from about 60 weak activations at t=2, and never in the delimiter or copy phases. Magnitude is nearly constant: about 1.21 when s is at t=0, and at t=1 it depends on the preceding token: 1.333 (the max) after e, about 1.21 after digits like 3, and lower (about 1.09-1.16) after v, w, r.

issues: Minor: on the test split there are 59 missed activations, all on s at t=2. They are very weak (0.03 to 0.05 of max, 0.0% of activation mass) and appear only when the first two tokens are a/c followed by q or y. This matches the explanation's '~60 weak activations at t=2', so it is not a systematic gap.

All factual claims check out on the dev profile: zero activations in the delimiter and copy phases; activation mass split 0.497 at t=0 and 0.503 at t=1; fires on in_tok s only; also fires on 's s' (prev_tok s gives 618 activations); top activations are 1.333 after e; about 1.207 at t=0 and after 3; lowest quartile is after w, v and r (1.09 to 1.16).
On the test split there are 0 false positives (precision 1.0), recall is 0.998, mass recall is 0.9999 and F1 is 0.999.
